lines.name: Harbour Line
lines.beyond: north on Harbour Road past Crown Road (y 320); south on Sunset Way past Comet Row (y -780); termini and depot off-sheet

notes: On sources: the critic says e6ffe1ba…, c1909f… and e20799f… were not retrieved, but all three are in the retrieved set (the T1 line, the plan's open questions and the 'why' notes), so I still cite them. Tide's draft comes from the brief itself, not from a passage. Aster: please confirm what the draft contains, since no passage holds it.

S1 and T1 are kept unchanged. The plan's concept note [cfba…] ends T1 on the circus balloon loop. The brief's draft runs T1 through the circus. The plan's open questions [c190…] leave this to Sky, so I have not resolved it. If Sky wants it, T1 can run on over the island, up Crown Avenue, then turn west on Crown Road at R50 to the sheet edge.

No two-way Sky Loop is proposed. The concept [cfba…] picks one straight S1 trunk over public space, and retiring the loops is an open question for Sky [c190…]. Geometry: an R70 fillet (minimum from the skyrail standards) at a ring corner swings about 29 m inside the vertex. The kerb corner of two 24 m roads is only about 17 m in, so the beam would pass over corner plots, which fails S-C1.

T2 Harbour Line runs through. There is no street south of Comet Row and no street space on the sheet for a balloon loop of R25 or more, so T2 cannot end inside the sheet (T-L1). Route: north edge, down Harbour Road, west along Market Street crossing T1 at grade, down Sunset Way to the south edge. Both ends reach the sheet edge (N-D1). One path, so no order is needed.

T-C1 corners, worked by hand, not yet run through the checker. Harbour Road/Market Street: arc centre (256.5,-366.5), kerb corner 46.7 m away, inner track at r 48.2. Market Street/Sunset Way: arc centre (-298,-453.5), kerb corner 45.7 m away, inner track at r 48.2. The S-curve between x -140 and -200 moves the line 13 m across Market Street's median on R50 fillets.

N-C1 room for interchanges (Vantage places the stops). T2 meets T1 at Boulevard × Market Street (0,-416.5), 36 m from T1's Records stop. T2 meets S1 under the beam at Harbour Road (306.5,0), 33.5 m from Harbour station. Both are within the 150 m interchange limit.

Conflict for Aster: the plan concept calls Crown Circus 'the one interchange' [cfba…]. If Sky accepts T2, there are two more: Records/Market Street and Harbour. The concept note would then need updating, and that note belongs to the plan owner (me) once Sky decides.

Handoffs. Waymark: T2 runs along Market Street past both Records Precinct gates (Rocket Lane and Satellite Street), so a T2 stop there is a station for police to seal. Pulse: T1 and T2 cross on the level (a diamond crossing) at Boulevard × Market Street. Done-check: bun tools/plan/cli.ts exits 0. I have not run it here (no shell). Keel to review.
